_doc: Phase 061 labelled set: 200 hand-written utterances of village speech, each with the speech act it should give (label), or null when no act should place it. Written from the act meanings in packs/bigville/world/speech_acts.json, not from the grammar. speaker, listener and names are the people in the exchange and in view (the context a parser gets). error (optional) is the reply a scripted small model gives for the line in the second arm: a plausible mistake, chosen by hand. The labels are judgements about meaning, and a reader may disagree with some of them.
